'''Nigh Kris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spymaster/Legends|spymaster]] who was employed by [[Prodoranya]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Nigh Kris and Prodoranya's [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[J'virgo N'yen]] accompanied Prodoranya to [[Solida Hesk's resort]] on [[Makeb]], where the two were killed.

==Behind the scenes==
Nigh Kris appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Makeb. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
